definitions.explanation: To make less in number or amount.

examples.japanese: {体重|たいじゅう}を{減|へ}らす。
ストレスを{減|へ}らすために、{毎日|まいにち}{散歩|さんぽ}をしている。
examples.english: I take a walk every day to reduce stress.

notes:
{減|へ}らす means to reduce, decrease, or cut down on something.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {減|へ}る (intransitive) - something decreases on its own
- Pattern: [something]を{減|へ}らす

OPPOSITE PAIR:
- {減|へ}らす ↔ {増|ふ}やす (to increase - transitive)
- {減|へ}る ↔ {増|ふ}える (to increase - intransitive)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {体重|たいじゅう}を{減|へ}らす: to lose weight
- {無駄|むだ}を{減|へ}らす: to reduce waste
- {費用|ひよう}を{減|へ}らす: to cut costs
- {時間|じかん}を{減|へ}らす: to reduce time
- ストレスを{減|へ}らす: to reduce stress

IDIOM:
{腹|はら}を{減|へ}らす literally 'to reduce one's stomach' means 'to get hungry.'
